reconstruction: Start from the pinned baseline. For each overlay_files entry, read the named tar member and write it to the corresponding repository-relative path. Verify every file against the named source snapshot before running its recorded command. Do not guess the missing early files. Full baseline/final and later prototype snapshots are reconstructible; the early partial snapshots retain only their available files, hashes and logs.
limitations: boundary-retention attempt 1 also changed source during execution and is excluded from correctness credit. External diagnostic .rs.txt inputs and WASM manifests are retained separately; historical /tmp path locations require local setup, not a shipped package.
